title: DMC3 HD PAC runtime slot-table evidence

records.title: PAC slot table uses 32-bit base-relative offsets
records.summary: The DMC3 stage-PAC consumer reads slotCount from the PAC header and resolves members through the relative-offset table beginning at +0x08. In the confirmed stage consumer, member 3 is read from PAC+0x14 and member 6 from PAC+0x20, proving a four-byte offset-table stride; a zero offset represents an empty slot in the reconciled PAC/PNST runtime model.

locations.note: Function 0x140245DE0 resolves multiple main-stage PAC members directly from the PAC offset table; member 3 uses PAC+0x14 and member 6 uses PAC+0x20. No proprietary PAC bytes are included in this packet.
